schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: A flagship central sector scheme providing direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year direct cash transfer in 3 four-monthly installments of ₹2,000
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts
Assistance for purchasing agricultural inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and equipment
Complete financial liquidity support during sowing and harvest seasons
schemes.tags: farmer income support agriculture cultivation land kisan dbt cash transfer crop input
documents_required: Proof of Agricultural Land Ownership (Khatauni / 7-12 extract)
application_process: Step 1: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit nearest CSC center.
Step 2: Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner.
Step 3: Enter your Aadhaar number, State, and Captcha code to verify.
Step 4: Fill in Land Details (Survey/Khata Number, Khasra Number, Area).
Step 5: Complete e-KYC using OTP or biometric verification and submit.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.hindi_name: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.description: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme offering secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Cashless and paperless inpatient health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers over 1,949 medical treatments, surgeries, ICU, daycare, and diagnostics
No limit on family size, age, or gender
Covers pre-existing conditions from Day 1 at 27,000+ empaneled public & private hospitals nationwide
Free Ayushman Golden Card for cashless admissions
schemes.tags: health insurance hospital medical treatment surgery cashless ayushman card 5 lakh free healthcare
documents_required: Ration Card / SECC 2011 proof or Family ID
application_process: Step 1: Check your eligibility on pmjay.gov.in or the Ayushman App using Aadhaar/Ration Card.
Step 2: Visit any Empaneled Health Care Provider (EHCP) hospital or CSC center with your Aadhaar and Ration card.
Step 3: Ayushman Mitra verifies your KYC details.
Step 4: Download and receive your Ayushman Card immediately on your smartphone or PVC printout.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Comprehensive agricultural insurance scheme safeguarding farmers against crop loss or damage arising from unforeseen weather events, droughts, floods, pests, and natural disasters at minimal premium rates (1.5% to 2%).
benefits: Comprehensive risk coverage from pre-sowing to post-harvest losses
Extremely low farmer premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops
Balance premium heavily subsidized by Central and State Governments
Fast claims settlement directly into bank accounts via satellite and drone assessment
schemes.tags: crop insurance fasal bima agriculture drought flood compensation harvest risk protection
documents_required: Land Record (RoR / Khasra / Khatauni / Tenant agreement)
Sowing Certificate / Declaration from Patwari or Village Officer
application_process: Step 1: Go to pmfby.gov.in or your local bank branch / CSC.
Step 2: Select 'Farmer Application' and login with your mobile number.
Step 3: Select Season (Kharif/Rabi), Year, Scheme, State, and Bank Account.
Step 4: Upload Land and Sowing details, pay nominal premium, and download policy receipt.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.description: Holistic support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools. Provides recognized certification, modern toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, skill upgrade training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 Lakhs at subsidized 5% interest.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card recognition as certified artisan
Skill training (5-7 days basic, 15 days advanced) with ₹500 per day stipend
₹15,000 modern toolkit incentive grant
Collateral-free enterprise credit: 1st tranche up to ₹1,00,000 (18 mo) and 2nd tranche up to ₹2,00,000 (30 mo) at concessional 5% interest
Incentive for digital transactions (₹1 per transaction up to 100/month) and marketing linkages
schemes.tags: artisan vishwakarma craft toolkit 15000 stipend loan 5 percent interest carpenter tailor mason pottery
application_process: Step 1: Visit your nearest Common Services Centre (CSC).
Step 2: Biometric authentication and registration under your specific trade (e.g. Tailor, Carpenter, Mason).
Step 3: Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body verification followed by Screening Committee approval.
Step 4: Download Digital PM Vishwakarma Certificate & enroll in basic training to receive ₹15k toolkit grant.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Enables micro and small enterprises to access collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 Lakhs across Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L-₹20L) categories for non-farm income generating activities.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakhs for micro-enterprises and startups
3 Loan Tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000), Tarun (₹5,00,000 to ₹20,00,000)
Zero processing fees for Shishu and Kishore loans
MUDRA RuPay Debit Card for seamless working capital withdrawals
Supports manufacturing, trading, retail shops, food processing, logistics, and service businesses
schemes.tags: mudra loan business funding shishu kishore tarun working capital startup no collateral credit
documents_required: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
Business Registration / Udhyam Aadhar / Trade License
Business project report / quotation of machinery or inventory
application_process: Step 1: Apply online via JanSamarth Portal (jansamarth.in) or visit any commercial bank, RRB, or MFI.
Step 2: Choose loan category (Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun) and input business proposal details.
Step 3: Upload KYC and business documents.
Step 4: Bank assesses application and sanctions collateral-free MUDRA loan with RuPay card.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.hindi_name: पीएम सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.description: Revolutionary rooftop solar scheme providing direct central financial subsidy up to ₹78,000 for installing solar systems on residential homes, delivering up to 300 units of free electricity every month.
benefits: Direct central capital subsidy: ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW+ rooftop solar systems
Up to 300 units of free clean solar electricity per month per household
Sell excess surplus electricity back to the grid for extra passive income
Low-interest concessional collateral-free bank loans (around 7% interest) for remaining system cost
schemes.tags: solar rooftop electricity subsidy free bijli energy green power renewable panel surya ghar 78000
documents_required: Electricity Consumer Account Number (CA / Consumer ID on latest bill)
Bank Account Passbook / Cancelled Cheque (for direct subsidy deposit)
Proof of Roof Ownership / Electricity Bill in applicant's name
application_process: Step 1: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with your State, DISCOM electricity provider, and Consumer Account Number.
Step 2: Apply for Rooftop Solar installation and choose an empaneled registered vendor.
Step 3: Vendor installs solar panels; DISCOM conducts inspection and installs Net Meter.
Step 4: Commissioning Certificate generated; enter bank details to receive subsidy in your account within 30 days.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.description: High-interest, government-backed small savings scheme under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign designed exclusively for girl children below 10 years of age to build a massive educational and marriage corpus with triple tax exemptions (EEE).
benefits: Highest guaranteed sovereign interest rate (currently 8.2% per annum compounded annually)
Triple Tax Exemption (EEE): Deposit, interest earned, and maturity proceeds are 100% tax-free under Section 80C
Flexible deposit range: Minimum ₹250 and maximum ₹1,50,000 per financial year
50% partial withdrawal allowed for higher education once girl reaches age 18 or passes 10th grade
Account matures after 21 years from opening date or upon girl's marriage after age 18
schemes.tags: sukanya samriddhi girl child beti bachao high interest tax free saving education marriage 8.2 percent
documents_required: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card of the Parent / Legal Guardian
Passport size photographs of Child and Parent
application_process: Step 1: Download SSY Account Opening Form from India Post or any authorized commercial bank (SBI, PNB, HDFC, etc.).
Step 2: Fill the form with child and guardian details.
Step 3: Attach Birth Certificate and Guardian KYC documents with initial deposit (min ₹250).
Step 4: Receive the official SSY Passbook to track deposits and compounding interest.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
schemes.description: Skill certification initiative empowering youth with industry-relevant technical, digital, and vocational training across Industry 4.0, AI, Robotics, Mechatronics, Green Energy, Coding, and traditional sectors with 100% fee subsidy, free certification, and placement assistance.
benefits: 100% fee-free industry-aligned vocational and digital skill training
Government-recognized Skill India Certificate upon assessment
Direct financial stipend / reward assistance upon certification
Dedicated placement drives, Rozgar Melas, and apprenticeship linkages
Specialized courses in AI, IoT, Drones, Solar Technology, Coding, and Hospitality
schemes.tags: skill training youth job placement certificate course vocational technical digital coding pmkvy
application_process: Step 1: Register on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in).
Step 2: Search for training courses in your preferred trade and district.
Step 3: Enroll at the nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) or online batch.
Step 4: Complete training, clear assessment, receive Skill India Certificate and job placement support.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors in tranches of ₹10,000 (1st loan), ₹20,000 (2nd loan), and ₹50,000 (3rd loan) with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan: ₹10k in 1st stage, ₹20k in 2nd stage, and up to ₹50k in 3rd stage
7% per annum interest subsidy credited directly to bank account on timely repayment
Cashback reward of up to ₹1,200 per year on conducting digital transactions via UPI/QR code
Builds credit score enabling higher commercial business loans in future
schemes.tags: street vendor hawker svanidhi loan 10000 20000 50000 working capital no collateral cashback upi
documents_required: Vending Certificate / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_process: Step 1: Check your vendor survey status on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar and verify via OTP.
Step 3: Select preferred lending institution (LBS, Bank, or MFI).
Step 4: Submit application online or via nearest Banking Correspondent (BC) / CSC for loan disbursal within 7 days.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
schemes.description: Flagship urban housing mission providing interest subsidies up to ₹2.67 Lakhs on home loans and direct financial grants of ₹1.5 Lakh to ₹2.5 Lakh for building or buying a pucca house with basic amenities.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on housing loans (saving up to ₹2.67 Lakhs in interest) under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)
Direct central assistance of ₹1.5 Lakh for beneficiary-led individual house construction (BLC)
Mandatory ownership in the name of female head of the family or joint ownership
Houses equipped with toilet, electricity, LPG connection, and drinking water
schemes.tags: housing urban home loan interest subsidy pucca house flat construction pmay credit linked
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Affidavit declaring no pucca house is owned anywhere in India
Property documents / Land Registry / Allotment Letter
application_process: Step 1: Visit pmaymis.gov.in and click on 'Citizen Assessment'.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar details to verify.
Step 3: Fill personal, income, and proposed house details.
Step 4: Submit online or apply directly through your housing loan lending bank.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/tribal areas to homeless rural families and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses to build a 25 sq.m pucca house.
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 (plains) / ₹1,30,000 (hilly/NE/Integrated Action Plan districts) in 3 installments
Additional 90/95 days of unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA (approx ₹20,000+)
Additional ₹12,000 financial incentive for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission
Free LPG connection under PM Ujjwala and electricity under Saubhagya
schemes.tags: rural housing gramin house construction 120000 grant bpl kutcha home mgnrega toilet
documents_required: Bank Account Details linked with Aadhaar
Land possession certificate / Gram Panchayat NOC
application_process: Step 1: Check your family name in the Gram Sabha Awaas+ Priority List.
Step 2: Gram Panchayat Secretary / Block Development Officer registers verified beneficiaries on AwaasSoft.
Step 3: Geo-tagged photo of existing kutcha site uploaded by official.
Step 4: Grant credited directly via DBT in 3 stage-linked installments (Foundation, Lintel, Completion).

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
schemes.description: Distributes 100% free LPG gas connections along with a free first cylinder and double-burner stove to adult women from poor and underprivileged households, eliminating indoor air pollution.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection for the adult female head of household
First 14.2 kg LPG cylinder refill provided completely free of cost
Free hotplate (double-burner gas stove) included
Targeted subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder directly in bank account on refills up to 12 cylinders/year
Self-declaration mechanism for migrant families without permanent address proof
schemes.tags: ujjwala gas cylinder lpg connection free stove subsidy women bpl clean cooking energy
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of the Applicant (Adult Woman)
Ration Card / Proof of BPL or Family composition document
application_process: Step 1: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or visit any local Indane, Bharat Gas, or HP Gas distributor.
Step 2: Submit Ujjwala 2.0 application form with Aadhaar and Ration Card.
Step 3: Distributor verifies eligibility via OMC centralized database.
Step 4: Receive free LPG gas connection, regulator, pipe, and stove at your doorstep.

schemes.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Pre & Post Matric Scholarships
schemes.description: Unified national platform disbursing over ₹4,000+ Crores annually in pre-matric, post-matric, merit-cum-means, and top-class higher education scholarships to SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Minority, and Divyangjan students.
benefits: Full tuition fee waiver/reimbursement for higher education, engineering, medical, and degree courses
Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers and ₹550/month for day scholars
One-time book allowance, study tour grant, and computer hardware support for top-tier institutes
Direct DBT disbursement into student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account
schemes.tags: scholarship chhatravritti college tuition fee student education post matric pre matric merit
documents_required: Previous Year Academic Marksheet / Passing Certificate
Income Certificate of parents (annual income under ₹2.5L)
Fee Receipt & Bonafide Student Certificate from School/College
application_process: Step 1: Go to scholarships.gov.in and generate One-Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar.
Step 2: Login and select eligible scholarship scheme (e.g. Post-Matric SC/ST/OBC or Merit-cum-Means).
Step 3: Fill academic course details and upload Fee Receipt + Marksheet.
Step 4: Institute verifies online, and scholarship funds are credited via DBT.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: Government-guaranteed pension scheme for all unorganized sector workers ensuring a fixed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after reaching 60 years of age.
benefits: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60
Spouse receives identical 100% pension amount after subscriber's demise
Full accumulated pension wealth (corpus up to ₹8.5 Lakhs) returned to nominee after death of spouse
Extremely low monthly contribution (e.g. ₹42/month for ₹1,000 pension if joined at age 18)
Tax benefits under Section 80CCD(1B)
schemes.tags: pension old age retirement security atal pension apy monthly income 5000 unorganized
documents_required: Active Savings Bank Account / Post Office Savings Account
application_process: Step 1: Visit your bank branch or access your NetBanking / mobile banking app.
Step 2: Choose desired pension tier (₹1,000 to ₹5,000/month).
Step 3: Enable monthly/quarterly auto-debit from your savings account.
Step 4: Receive your Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) Card instantly.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.description: Direct maternity cash benefit scheme granting ₹5,000 for the first child (in 2 installments) and ₹6,000 for the second girl child to compensate for wage loss, improve nutrition, and promote institutional deliveries.
benefits: Cash benefit of ₹5,000 for 1st live birth (₹3,000 at early pregnancy registration + ANC, ₹2,000 at childbirth & vaccination)
Enhanced direct cash incentive of ₹6,000 in a single installment for 2nd child if newborn is a girl child
Improves maternal health, nutrition, and institutional deliveries
Direct cash transfer to the mother's Aadhaar-linked bank account
schemes.tags: maternity pregnancy child birth cash incentive mother nutrition vaccination matru vandana
documents_required: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card from Anganwadi / Health Centre
application_process: Step 1: Register at the local Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
Step 2: Submit MCP Card with verified Antenatal Check-up (ANC) details.
Step 3: Beneficiary details validated via Poshan Tracker.
Step 4: Cash installments credited directly via PFMS to the mother's bank account.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.description: Credit-linked subsidy program to generate self-employment ventures in manufacturing (project cost up to ₹50 Lakhs) and service sectors (up to ₹20 Lakhs) with government margin money subsidy of 15% to 35%.
benefits: Bank-financed loans up to ₹50 Lakhs for Manufacturing units and up to ₹20 Lakhs for Service enterprises
Government capital subsidy (Margin Money): 15% to 25% for General category, 25% to 35% for SC/ST/OBC/Women/Rural
Own contribution required is only 5% to 10% of total project cost
Second loan up to ₹1 Crore available for upgrading existing performing PMEGP units with 15% subsidy
schemes.tags: business loan subsidy startup manufacturing service self employment 35 percent subsidy pmegp kvic
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR) / Business Feasibility Plan
Educational Qualification (Minimum 8th pass for projects above ₹10L manufacturing / ₹5L service)
Special Category / Caste Certificate (if claiming 35% subsidy)
Rural Area Certificate from local Gram Panchayat (if applicable)
application_process: Step 1: Visit kviconline.gov.in and fill the PMEGP online application for individual entrepreneur.
Step 2: Upload DPR, Aadhaar, Caste certificate, and 8th standard marksheet.
Step 3: District Task Force Committee (DTFC) reviews and forwards to selected financing bank.
Step 4: Bank sanctions loan, entrepreneur attends Entrepreneurship Development Program (EDP), and Margin Money subsidy is credited.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one Woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Bank composite loans ranging from ₹10 Lakhs up to ₹1 Crore for greenfield projects
Covers manufacturing, services, trading, and agri-allied activities
Repayable in 7 years with a moratorium period up to 18 months
Concessional interest rate (lowest applicable for the category not exceeding Base Rate + 3% + Tenor Premium)
Dedicated handholding support through SIDBI and NABARD
schemes.tags: standup india woman loan 1 crore sc st business enterprise greenfield trading manufacturing sidbi
documents_required: Proof of Identity & Address (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID)
Company / Enterprise Registration showing 51% shareholding by SC/ST or Woman
Project Report with cost of machinery and working capital requirement
Last 3 years Balance Sheet / ITR if existing entity
application_process: Step 1: Register on standupmitra.in portal.
Step 2: Choose your preference: 'Trainee Borrower' (for handholding) or 'Ready Borrower'.
Step 3: Complete common loan application form and select financing bank branch.
Step 4: Track application status until formal loan sanction and credit release.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: National mission for financial inclusion ensuring every unbanked adult in India has access to a zero-balance bank account, RuPay debit card with ₹2 Lakh accident insurance, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
benefits: Zero minimum balance savings bank account with zero maintenance fees
Free RuPay Debit Card with built-in ₹2,00,000 accidental insurance cover
Overdraft (OD) facility up to ₹10,000 for eligible account holders after 6 months satisfactory operation
Direct receipt of all government DBT subsidies (LPG, PM-KISAN, Scholarships, Pensions)
Easy access to micro-insurance (PMJJBY, PMSBY) and micro-pension (APY)
schemes.tags: bank account zero balance jan dhan rupay card debit overdraft insurance financial inclusion
documents_required: If Aadhaar not available: Voter ID / PAN / Passport / NREGA Job Card
application_process: Step 1: Visit any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Bank Mitra (CSP outlet).
Step 2: Fill simple one-page Jan Dhan Account Opening Form.
Step 3: Provide Aadhaar and biometric verification.
Step 4: Receive your passbook and RuPay debit card with ₹2L accident insurance on the spot.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.description: Affordable government life insurance scheme offering ₹2,00,000 life cover in case of death of the insured person due to any reason at a nominal premium of only ₹436 per year.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover payable to family/nominee on death of the insured due to any cause
Unbeatable premium rate: Only ₹436 per annum (less than ₹1.20 per day)
Auto-debit directly from savings bank account once a year in May/June
No medical test required for enrollment
schemes.tags: life insurance term insurance death cover 2 lakh low premium 436 bima bank nominee
documents_required: Savings Bank Account with active auto-debit consent
application_process: Step 1: Login to your Mobile/NetBanking or visit your bank branch / Post Office.
Step 2: Fill PMJJBY consent-cum-declaration form.
Step 3: Enable auto-debit of ₹436 annual premium.
Step 4: Receive Certificate of Insurance instantly via SMS and email.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.description: Ultra-affordable accidental insurance providing ₹2,00,000 cover for accidental death and permanent total disability, and ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability for a premium of just ₹20 per year.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability (loss of both eyes or both hands/feet)
₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability (loss of one eye or one hand/foot)
Lowest premium in the world: Only ₹20 per year auto-debited in single installment
Simple, prompt claim settlement via bank branch
schemes.tags: accident insurance 20 rupees accidental death disability injury 2 lakh cover pmsby
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account
application_process: Step 1: Access your NetBanking / Mobile Banking app or visit your bank branch.
Step 2: Submit simple PMSBY enrollment form.
Step 3: Authorize ₹20 annual auto-debit.
Step 4: Receive SMS confirmation with Policy acknowledgment.

schemes.name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
schemes.hindi_name: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम
schemes.description: World's largest legal employment guarantee ensuring at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in every financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per financial year per rural household
Unemployment allowance legally payable if work not provided within 15 days of application
Statutory minimum wage paid weekly directly into bank / post office accounts via ABPS
Equal wages for male and female workers with crèche and water facilities at worksites
Builds durable community assets (water ponds, irrigation canals, rural roads, plantation)
schemes.tags: nrega mgnrega job card 100 days work wage employment rural livelihood manual labor
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of all adult household members
Proof of Rural Residence (Ration card / Voter ID)
application_process: Step 1: Submit written or oral application to the Gram Panchayat.
Step 2: Gram Panchayat verifies residence and issues MGNREGA Job Card within 15 days.
Step 3: Submit application for work indicating the duration for which employment is sought.
Step 4: Receive dated receipt and work allocation within 5 km radius of village with weekly wage DBT.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop)
schemes.description: Enhances farm water productivity through micro-irrigation systems (Drip and Sprinkler irrigation) with 45% to 55% direct capital subsidy to ensure 'Har Khet Ko Pani' and 'Per Drop More Crop'.
benefits: Capital subsidy up to 55% for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers for installing Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation
Saves 40% to 50% water while increasing agricultural crop yield by 30% to 40%
Subsidy on micro-irrigation equipment, diesel/solar water pumps, and water storage ponds
Fertigation capability for saving expensive fertilizer consumption
schemes.tags: irrigation drip sprinkler water pump sinchayee agriculture subsidy water saving kisan
documents_required: Water source certificate (Borewell / Canal / Well NOC)
application_process: Step 1: Apply on State Horticulture / Agriculture Department Micro-Irrigation portal (or pmksy.gov.in).
Step 2: Select empaneled micro-irrigation manufacturer/dealer.
Step 3: Field verification and GPS survey by Agriculture Officer.
Step 4: System installed at farm; direct subsidy credited to farmer's account / manufacturer.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.description: Old-age pension protection for unorganized workers (street vendors, domestic workers, rickshaw pullers, construction laborers) earning under ₹15,000/month with 50:50 matching contribution by Central Government.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 per month after attaining age 60
50% matching contribution deposited directly by Central Government into subscriber's pension fund
Affordable entry: Monthly contribution of just ₹55 (at age 18) to ₹200 (at age 40)
Spouse entitled to 50% family pension upon death of pensioner
schemes.tags: shram yogi pension 3000 monthly unorganized labor matching contribution retirement
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC
application_process: Step 1: Visit nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) or self-enroll at maandhan.in.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar and Bank Details.
Step 3: First contribution paid in cash at CSC; auto-debit mandate generated.
Step 4: Receive instant printed Shram Yogi Pension Card with unique SYM number.

schemes.name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 hectares of cultivable land ensuring ₹3,000 monthly pension on reaching 60 years of age.
benefits: Fixed monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon reaching 60 years of age
Equal 1:1 matching contribution contributed by Government of India
Farmer contribution can be auto-debited directly from PM-KISAN quarterly installments (no out-of-pocket payment needed)
Spouse receives ₹1,500/month family pension on demise of subscriber
schemes.tags: farmer pension 3000 kisan mandhan old age security small marginal farmers pmkmy
documents_required: Khasra / Khatauni land ownership document (up to 2 hectares)
Savings Bank Account Details linked with PM-KISAN
application_process: Step 1: Visit nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) or visit maandhan.in/kisan.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar and verify with biometric authentication.
Step 3: Opt for contribution deduction from PM-KISAN installment or bank account.
Step 4: Receive printed Kisan Pension Card.

schemes.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance up to ₹20 Lakhs as grant for proof of concept and prototype development, and up to ₹50 Lakhs for market entry and commercialization via convertible debentures or debt to DPIIT-recognized startups.
benefits: Up to ₹20 Lakhs direct grant for Proof of Concept (PoC), prototype validation, and product trials
Up to ₹50 Lakhs for commercialization, market entry, and scaling via convertible debentures or debt-linked instruments
Mentorship and incubator workspace support across 150+ selected incubators across India
Fast-track patent examination at 80% discounted official government fees
schemes.tags: startup seed fund grant 50 lakh prototype incubation dpiit entrepreneur innovation venture
documents_required: Pitch Deck / Business Plan & Financial Model
Proof of Concept / Prototype Demo video or documentation
application_process: Step 1: Get DPIIT recognition on startupindia.gov.in.
Step 2: Login to seedfund.startupindia.gov.in and apply as Startup.
Step 3: Select up to 3 preferred incubators aligned with your sector.
Step 4: Present your pitch to the Incubator Seed Management Committee (ISMC) for milestone-based disbursement.

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
schemes.hindi_name: जल जीवन मिशन - हर घर जल
schemes.description: National mission providing individual Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) delivering 55 litres per capita per day of clean, potable drinking water on regular and long-term basis to every rural household.
benefits: 100% free functional household tap water connection installed at doorstep
Guaranteed 55 litres per person per day of tested, clean, potable drinking water
Eliminates the burden of walking miles to fetch water, especially for women and children
Community-led water quality monitoring and gray-water management
schemes.tags: water tap connection har ghar jal drinking water pipeline rural infrastructure jal jeevan
documents_required: House ownership / Gram Panchayat residence verification
application_process: Step 1: Implemented village-wide through Village Water & Sanitation Committee (VWSC) / Pani Samiti.
Step 2: Check village implementation schedule on ejalshakti.gov.in dashboard.
Step 3: Gram Panchayat executes household pipeline connection at zero installation cost.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Free scientific soil testing and customized crop nutrient recommendations issued to farmers every 2 years, optimizing fertilizer usage, cutting farming costs by 15-20%, and boosting crop yield.
benefits: Free laboratory testing of 12 critical soil health parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC)
Personalized crop-wise fertilizer and dosage recommendations to stop wasteful chemical spending
Reduces input cost by up to 20% and enhances soil fertility and crop productivity by 10-15%
Digital soil health card accessible online anytime
schemes.tags: soil testing fertilizer card soil health agriculture nutrients crop yield farming cost reduction
documents_required: Land Record details (Survey number / Khasra number)
application_process: Step 1: Contact your local Village Agriculture Extension Officer or visit soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
Step 2: Agriculture officer collects geo-referenced soil sample from your farm.
Step 3: Sample tested in government soil laboratory.
Step 4: Download your 12-parameter Soil Health Card with custom fertilizer schedule.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
schemes.description: Provides high-quality generic medicines, surgical items, and nutraceuticals at 50% to 90% cheaper prices than branded market equivalents through over 10,000+ Jan Aushadhi Kendras across India.
benefits: Quality generic medicines available at 50% to 90% discount compared to expensive branded drugs
Over 1,965 essential medicines and 293 surgical consumables available across all major therapeutic areas
Oxo-biodegradable sanitary napkins (Suvidha) at only ₹1 per pad
Micro-entrepreneurship opportunity: Financial assistance up to ₹5 Lakhs for pharmacists/entrepreneurs to open a Janaushadhi Kendra
schemes.tags: generic medicine cheap pharmacy jan aushadhi discount discount drugs healthcare sanitary pad
documents_required: For opening Kendra: D.Pharm/B.Pharm degree, Aadhaar, PAN, Shop commercial lease
application_process: Step 1: Locate nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra using Jan Aushadhi Sugam App or janaushadhi.gov.in.
Step 2: Present doctor's prescription or generic medicine name to get medicines at 80% discount.
Step 3: To open a Kendra: Apply online at janaushadhi.gov.in with pharmacy registration.

schemes.name: Divyangjan Swavlamban Yojana & Unique Disability ID (UDID)
schemes.description: Unified national welfare and concessional financial assistance scheme providing UDID smart cards, free motorized tricycles/assistive aids (ADIP scheme), and concessional credit up to ₹50 Lakhs at 5% interest for Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan).
benefits: Single National UDID Smart Card recognized across all states for government reservations and travel concessions
Free distribution of modern assistive devices (hearing aids, wheelchairs, braille kits, motorized tri-cycles)
Concessional business and educational loans up to ₹50 Lakhs at subsidized interest rates starting from 5% per annum
Skill training stipend and monthly disability pension under NSAP
schemes.tags: disability divyangjan udid card wheelchair assistive aid loan 5 percent reservation handicapped
documents_required: Disability Certificate from Medical Board (minimum 40% disability)
application_process: Step 1: Register on swavlambancard.gov.in (UDID portal).
Step 2: Upload Disability Certificate, Aadhaar, and photo.
Step 3: Verification by Chief Medical Officer (CMO) / District Medical Authority.
Step 4: Download e-UDID card and receive PVC disability smart card at home via speed post.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.hindi_name: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
schemes.description: Non-contributory social security monthly pension provided to destitute and BPL senior citizens aged 60 and above to ensure dignity and financial independence in old age.
benefits: Direct monthly cash pension directly in bank account (combined Central + State assistance ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹3,000/month depending on state)
Higher pension tier for senior citizens aged 80 and above
100% non-contributory (no prior savings needed)
Direct Benefit Transfer directly linked with Aadhaar and Jan Dhan account
schemes.tags: old age pension senior citizen vridha pension bpl 60 years monthly cash welfare ignoaps
application_process: Step 1: Apply online at nsap.nic.in or through Block Development Office (BDO) / Tehsil / Municipal office / CSC.
Step 2: Submit BPL card, Aadhaar, and age verification.
Step 3: Verification by Gram Panchayat / Social Welfare Officer.
Step 4: Monthly pension sanctioned directly into bank account via DBT.

schemes.name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
schemes.description: Attractive 2-year sovereign small savings scheme designed for women and girls offering high guaranteed interest rate of 7.5% per annum with flexible deposit up to ₹2 Lakhs and partial withdrawal facility.
benefits: Guaranteed 7.5% per annum fixed interest compounded quarterly
Tenure of only 2 years (short lock-in period)
Flexible deposit limit from minimum ₹1,000 up to ₹2,00,000
Partial withdrawal of up to 40% of eligible balance allowed after 1 year
Available for women of all age groups and minors through legal guardians
schemes.tags: women savings 7.5 interest mahila samman high return post office short term fixed deposit
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of the Woman / Girl child
application_process: Step 1: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Step 2: Fill Application Form for Mahila Samman Savings Certificate.
Step 3: Deposit amount via cash or cheque (up to ₹2 Lakhs).
Step 4: Receive MSSC Passbook/Certificate with guaranteed 7.5% maturity yield.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
schemes.description: Nationwide infrastructure scheme connecting all eligible unconnected rural habitations with all-weather bituminous roads to enhance socioeconomic mobility, market access, and healthcare accessibility.
benefits: All-weather paved asphalt road connectivity directly to remote villages
Dramatically reduces travel time to schools, hospitals, agricultural APMC mandis, and railway stations
Boosts local rural economy, agricultural produce transport, and emergency medical ambulance access
High engineering standards with 5-year contractor maintenance guarantee
schemes.tags: rural roads infrastructure connectivity all weather road village development pmgsy
documents_required: Handled at Gram Panchayat and State Rural Roads Development Agency level
application_process: Step 1: Track rural road construction proposals on omms.nic.in.
Step 2: Gram Panchayat passes resolution for unconnected habitations (population 500+ in plains, 250+ in hills/tribal).
Step 3: State agency surveys and executes road project under central financing.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.description: Provides farmers, fishermen, and animal husbandry rearers with revolving credit limit up to ₹3 Lakhs at highly subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum (with 3% prompt repayment incentive) to meet crop production and working capital expenses.
benefits: Short-term agricultural crop loan up to ₹3,00,000 at effective 4% interest per annum (7% base - 3% prompt repayment rebate)
Collateral-free loan limit up to ₹1,60,000 (extended to ₹2,00,000 through tie-up)
Extended to Animal Husbandry, Dairy, Poultry, and Fisheries farmers (up to ₹2 Lakhs)
KCC RuPay Card for instant ATM cash withdrawal and point-of-sale fertilizer purchases
Inbuilt crop insurance and personal accident insurance cover
schemes.tags: kisan credit card kcc 4 percent interest cheap crop loan agricultural credit revolving limit
documents_required: Land Record (7/12, Khatauni / Revenue record showing land cultivating status)
application_process: Step 1: Download simple one-page KCC form from pmkisan.gov.in or jansamarth.in.
Step 2: Fill personal and land cultivation details.
Step 3: Submit to your local commercial bank, RRB, or Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS).
Step 4: Bank sanctions KCC credit limit and issues RuPay KCC card within 14 days.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
schemes.ministry: Women and Child Development Department (Govt of MP)
schemes.description: Flagship state women empowerment scheme providing monthly direct financial assistance of ₹1,250 directly into the bank accounts of 1.29 crore married women in Madhya Pradesh to foster economic self-reliance.
benefits: ₹1,250 transferred on the 10th of every month directly to woman's bank account via DBT
Annual total direct financial benefit of ₹15,000
Enhances household financial decision-making, nutrition, and health among rural and urban women
Aadhaar-linked automated direct credit without any commission or middlemen
schemes.tags: ladli behna madhya pradesh 1250 monthly women cash transfer dbt mahila yojana
documents_required: Samagra Family ID & Member ID (MP Samagra Portal)
Aadhaar Card (Aadhaar e-KYC verified with Samagra)
Individual Bank Account with active DBT enablement
application_process: Step 1: Ensure your Samagra e-KYC is completed and bank account is DBT active.
Step 2: Visit your Gram Panchayat / Ward camp with Samagra ID and Aadhaar.
Step 3: Camp operator fills online application form and takes live photo.
Step 4: Receive SMS with registration number; monthly ₹1,250 credited on 10th of each month.

schemes.name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
schemes.ministry: Department of Women & Child Development (Govt of NCT of Delhi)
schemes.description: Financial assistance scheme for girl children born in Delhi, depositing stage-wise cash incentives of ₹11,000 (birth) up to ₹35,000+ across school milestones (Class 1, 6, 9, 10, 12) to eradicate female foeticide and promote girls' higher education.
benefits: ₹11,000 financial assistance for institutional delivery of girl child in Delhi
₹5,000 deposited at admission into Class 1, Class 6, Class 9, Class 10, and Class 12
Funds accumulate in SBI Life Insurance with compounding interest; total payout at age 18 exceeds ₹1,00,000
Matures upon girl turning 18 and passing 10th standard for funding college or professional courses
schemes.tags: delhi ladli girl child education scholarship 35000 maturity sbi life birth incentive
documents_required: Birth Certificate of Girl Child (Born in Delhi)
Proof of 3 years continuous residence in Delhi (Ration Card / Voter ID / Electricity Bill)
Income Certificate (Parental annual income under ₹1 Lakh)
School admission certificate from recognized Delhi school
application_process: Step 1: Obtain Delhi Ladli application form from the school or District WCD office / edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in.
Step 2: Submit with Delhi residence proof, Income Certificate, and School verification.
Step 3: WCD Delhi sanctions funds into SBI Life Insurance Ladli corpus.
Step 4: Receive Sanction Letter and maturity payout upon passing Class 10/12 at age 18.

schemes.name: Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
schemes.description: Telangana government's pioneer Farmers' Investment Support Scheme providing ₹10,000 per acre per year (₹5,000 per acre per crop season for Kharif and Rabi) directly to landholding farmers for seeds, fertilizers, and pesticide inputs.
benefits: Direct investment support of ₹10,000 per acre per year (₹5,000 per acre per season)
No limit on acreage (paid proportionately for every acre owned)
Eliminates reliance on private moneylenders for crop sowing inputs
Direct electronic transfer to farmers' bank accounts through Integrated Land Records (Dharani portal)
schemes.tags: rythu bandhu telangana 10000 per acre farmer investment input subsidy dharani
application_process: Step 1: Ensure your land title is updated on Telangana Dharani portal.
Step 2: Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) verifies pattadar details in the village.
Step 3: Automated seasonal credit of ₹5,000/acre directly to bank account.

schemes.name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
schemes.ministry: Department of Women & Child Development (Govt of West Bengal)
schemes.description: UN Public Service Award-winning cash transfer scheme incentivizing unmarried teenage girls in West Bengal to stay in school through an annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (K1) and a one-time grant of ₹25,000 (K2) at age 18.
benefits: K1 Annual Scholarship of ₹1,000 for unmarried girls aged 13-18 studying in classes 8-12
K2 One-time Grant of ₹25,000 for unmarried girls turning 18 pursuing higher education or vocational training
Substantially reduces child marriage and female school dropout rates in West Bengal
Direct Benefit Transfer into girl's exclusive bank account
schemes.tags: kanyashree west bengal 25000 grant girl education child marriage prevention scholarship
documents_required: Proof of Enrollment in recognized school/college/vocational institution in WB
application_process: Step 1: Collect K1/K2 application form from your school or college in West Bengal.
Step 2: Fill details and attach Birth Certificate, Bank Passbook, and Unmarried Declaration.
Step 3: Head of Institution verifies and uploads to wb.kanyashree.gov.in portal.
Step 4: Receive funds directly in bank account with acknowledgement SMS.

schemes.name: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship Schemes (Maharashtra)
schemes.ministry: Social Justice & Special Assistance Dept (Govt of Maharashtra)
schemes.description: Comprehensive unified digital scholarship portal of Maharashtra covering 100% tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowances for SC, ST, VJNT, OBC, SBC, and EBC students enrolled in colleges, professional degrees, and polytechnics.
benefits: 100% Tuition fee and Exam fee reimbursement directly to college for SC/ST students (and 50% for OBC/EBC)
Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers and ₹550/month for day scholars
Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna for open category EBC students
Direct DBT disbursement linked with Aadhaar enabled bank account
schemes.tags: mahadbt maharashtra scholarship tuition fee reimbursement college post matric
documents_required: Caste Certificate & Caste Validity Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC/VJNT)
Income Certificate from Tehsildar (Annual income below ₹8L for EBC / ₹2.5L for SC/ST)
HSC / SSC Marksheet and College Allotment CAP letter
Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account
application_process: Step 1: Register on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in using Aadhaar authentication.
Step 2: Create profile, select Department (Social Justice / Tribal / Higher Education).
Step 3: Select enrolled course and upload Domicile, Caste, and Income certificates.
Step 4: College and District Social Welfare Officer verify online; fee reimbursement sent directly.

schemes.name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
schemes.description: World's largest school feeding program providing hot cooked nutritious meals with specified calorie and protein standards to all children studying in Classes 1 to 8 across government and government-aided schools.
benefits: Free hot cooked meal every school day for children in primary (450 calories, 12g protein) and upper primary (700 calories, 20g protein)
Enhanced with millets, fortified rice, and vegetables to tackle malnutrition and stunting
Improves school enrollment, retention, daily attendance, and classroom learning attention
Special supplementary nutrition provisions in aspirational and tribal districts
schemes.tags: school meal mid day meal nutrition food primary education poshan free lunch
documents_required: Enrolled student in any Government or Government-Aided School (no separate application needed)
application_process: Step 1: Automatic benefit upon enrolling child in Class 1-8 in any government or local body school.
Step 2: Hot nutritious meal served daily during school recess.

schemes.name: Bhashini: National Language Translation Mission
schemes.description: AI-powered digital mission delivering government services, voice interfaces, and digital content across 22 scheduled Indian languages, bridging the digital language barrier for non-English speakers.
benefits: Access public services, banking, UPI, and portals through natural voice in your mother tongue (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, etc.)
Real-time voice-to-voice and text translation across Indian languages
Voice-enabled UPI payments for rural and unlettered citizens
Crowdsource digital language tasks on Bhasha Daan with recognition and digital rewards
schemes.tags: digital india bhashini ai voice translation indian languages regional speech text
documents_required: Open to all citizens via mobile app or web browser
application_process: Step 1: Download Bhashini App from Google Play Store or visit bhashini.gov.in.
Step 2: Use voice translation to communicate in your native language with government portals and UPI.

schemes.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
schemes.hindi_name: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन
schemes.description: World's largest poverty alleviation program organizing over 10 crore rural women into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and providing Revolving Funds (₹20,000-₹30,000), Community Investment Funds (₹1.5 Lakh), and bank credit linkages up to ₹20 Lakhs at 7% interest.
benefits: Revolving Fund (RF) grant of ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 per SHG to cultivate saving habits
Community Investment Fund (CIF) of up to ₹1,50,000 per SHG for livelihood micro-enterprises
Collateral-free bank credit up to ₹20 Lakhs per SHG at subsidized 7% interest rate (and 4% on prompt repayment in select districts)
Training under 'Lakhpati Didi' initiative to enable women SHG members to earn sustainable annual income above ₹1,00,000
schemes.tags: self help group shg rural women lakhpati didi livelihood credit 7 percent interest nrlm
documents_required: SHG Resolution copy and Bank Account details
application_process: Step 1: Form or join a women's Self Help Group (10-15 members) in your village.
Step 2: Connect with the Village Organization (VO) / Cluster Level Federation (CLF) under NRLM.
Step 3: Open SHG savings account at local bank and receive Revolving Fund and subsidized credit linkage.

schemes.name: SVAMITVA Scheme (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology)
schemes.description: Drone-based cadastral mapping of inhabited rural village areas (Abadi) to issue legally validated digital Property Cards (Sampatti Card) to rural homeowners, enabling bank loan mortgaging and dispute-free property rights.
benefits: Official legal Ownership Property Card (Sampatti Card) for residential houses in rural Abadi areas
Enables villagers to use residential property as a financial asset to secure bank loans and credit
High-resolution 3D drone mapping eliminating property boundary disputes
Streamlines village property tax assessment and Gram Panchayat development planning
schemes.tags: property card svamitva drone survey village house ownership sampatti patta loan against property
documents_required: Existing Gram Panchayat property tax receipt or house possession proof
application_process: Step 1: Survey of India deploys drone over the village Abadi area.
Step 2: Feature extraction and ground truthing by Revenue Officials and Gram Panchayat.
Step 3: Objection period given to villagers to verify boundaries.
Step 4: Final legal Property Card (Sampatti Patra) generated and downloaded / handed over.

schemes.name: Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana (AHVY)
schemes.description: Mobilizes traditional handicraft artisans into self-reliant enterprise clusters through design workshops, modern technology infusion, artisan identity cards (Pehchan), and direct market exposure in national and international craft expos.
benefits: Issuance of official 'Pehchan' Artisan Photo Identity Card
Financial grant for raw material bank and common facility centers (CFC)
Design development workshops by National Institute of Design (NID) / NIFT experts
100% sponsored stalls at Dilli Haat, Surajkund Mela, and national handicraft exhibitions
Export promotion support and e-commerce onboarding on GeM and ONDC
schemes.tags: handicrafts artisan pehchan card textiles craft cluster exhibition stall subsidy
documents_required: Pehchan Artisan ID Card / Proof of Craft engagement
application_process: Step 1: Register on handicrafts.nic.in for Pehchan Card.
Step 2: Apply through local Assistant Director (Handicrafts) Service Centre.
Step 3: Cluster formation approved with Common Facility Centre and exhibition allotments.

schemes.name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.description: Provides 50% direct capital subsidy up to ₹50 Lakhs for establishing entrepreneurship ventures in sheep, goat, poultry, piggery farming, and fodder seed production units.
benefits: 50% direct capital subsidy up to ₹50 Lakhs for poultry breeding farm and hatchery units
50% capital subsidy up to ₹50 Lakhs for sheep & goat breeding farms (up to 500 females + 25 males)
50% capital subsidy up to ₹30 Lakhs for piggery breeding units and up to ₹50 Lakhs for fodder production
Direct credit into applicant's loan account through SIDBI in two equal tranches
schemes.tags: livestock animal husbandry poultry goat farming sheep piggery 50 percent subsidy nlm
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR) along with cost breakdown
Proof of Land (owned or minimum 10-year lease for farm setup)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Bank sanction letter
Training Certificate in Animal Husbandry (if available)
application_process: Step 1: Apply online on nlm.udyamimitra.in.
Step 2: Upload DPR and land ownership/lease documents.
Step 3: State Level Executive Committee (SLEC) and financing bank evaluate proposal.
Step 4: Subsidy credited in 2 milestones directly into bank loan account.
